lines.text: Lie on your back with your feet pressed against the wall. Two dancers lift your body upward while you keep your feet in contact with the wall. Straighten your legs as you rise. Let them lower you back down while maintaining the contact between your feet and the wall. Repeat the lifting and lowering action.
